code:
# The value is entered interactively (not typed on the command line where it could appear in shell history)

# It goes directly to Cloudflare's secure storage, not to any local file
npx wrangler secret put UPSTREAM_API_KEY
description: One command that sends a secret straight to Cloudflare's secure storage, never to a local file.

steps.description: This command stores a secret on Cloudflare. `npx wrangler secret put UPSTREAM_API_KEY` sends the value straight to Cloudflare's secure storage, not to any local file.
You enter the value interactively, so it never appears on the command line or in your shell history.
The value goes to Cloudflare's storage, so no file in your repository holds it.

title: Storing a Secret with wrangler
